cabinet1.description: Owner structural depth with cyan/violet painted panels framing the approved stacked logo.

lighting.source: Selected actual audio source from Studio audio state; Spotify metadata is not amplitude
lighting.emitter: Bounded additive glow, follows shared audio attack/release
lighting.receiver: Paint/material tint on registered surface only
lighting.occluder: Source baked shading retained; new moving cast shadows require explicit masks
lighting.reflector: Clipped to measured glass; upright reflection pose lookup only

marqueeOverhang.source: Physical overhang below marquee bottom at native y270
marqueeOverhang.curve: Linear receiver fade from strongest under lip to clear at reach; glass excluded.

reflection.placement: Only the ball top enters the bottom edge of glass. Real controls remain at approved pivots.
reflection.sourceRule: Crop pre-ball translucent sprite margins in reflection only; preserve original physical control sprite.

futureVariables: Independent ball gloss/shaft materials after source separation
Deck slope and thickness after reauthoring source geometry
Corner radius and shoulder profiles per new shell
Marquee glass roughness and reflection masks
Full-body coin door/grille/base only in full-body styles

logoContract.placement: Centered, contained by native marquee height. Paint fills the remaining face; never flatten lettering to fill width.

required: Every new shell retains or constructs panel thickness and return faces
Bezel must have outer bevel, recessed face, inner lip and protected clear aperture
Paint follows registered panel planes; never a plain outline around a flat fill
Shoulder corners below the marquee get broad composed splashes in painted styles
Seams, miters, fasteners and original contact shadows stay legible above painted laminate
Lighting emission is limited to trim/logo/light masks; receivers retain dark-side shading
Reflections exclude buttons/arrows; upright ball arc only, faint and at lower glass edge
Approved logo keeps original glyph proportions
A reskinned panel replaces its old printed graphics AND matching interior FX; never ghost old stripes through new art
Paint composition covers the upper bridge, both uprights and lower sill around glass, while preserving the inner lip and bevels
Mask paint away from trim using a configurable pixel gutter; restore original depth before applying one chosen trim color
Upper return faces have independent material color, painted coverage and an explicit marquee overhang shadow
Sphere light is fixed in scene coordinates and recomputed for every source pose; never rotate or duplicate baked highlights
Nine button accents are palette roles; cap and rim accept separate neutral/pressed overrides
Future shell shape concepts stay roadmap work until the current original silhouette is accepted
surfaceDetailRules.pixelArt: Sharp source pixels and dithered shading; no blur replacing physical detail
surfaceDetailRules.acceptance: Compare original and painted native view, inspect shoulder corners and glass on a dark/checkerboard backdrop. Reject flat outline-only shell variants.

strictPixelArt.controls: Keep source pixel clusters, dithering, highlights, alpha and pose silhouettes. Palette remapping only; no procedural smooth sphere shading.
strictPixelArt.directionalLighting: Saved settings retained; directional relighting pending authored pixel masks and owner review.

deckReskin.material: Opaque new laminate base, paint atlas, restrained pixel grain, inset contact seam and mounting screws. Never restore old face pixels over a reskin.

button.maskRule: Analytic cap ellipse intersected with source alpha; rim is colored housing outside cap, source contact shadow retained.

controlGeometry.ballModel: Source-palette remapping preserves the original per-pose pixel shading, dither, alpha, shaft and pivots. Smooth analytic sphere replacement is prohibited. Directional lighting settings are retained but inactive until authored pixel masks pass visual review.

sourcePsd.placementPolicy: Retain owner-approved current alignment; Beta has a 1px source origin difference and four extra bottom rows. Do not silently shift or resize the measured aperture.
limitations: Body trim, seams and panel print are flattened into CABINET
Button cap and rim are not separate layers
Ball, shaft and baked shading are joined in each pose sprite
No editable text layer/font definition in the four inspected documents
SCREEN layer bounds are content plates, not capture-aperture measurements

marqueeFace.policy: Paint reaches the inner frame on the full trapezoidal face. Native source trim remains outside the polygon; logo uses uniform contain fit. Gameplay aperture and header projection remain fixed.

buttonMountAuthoring.status: concepts-only; exact registered layers not yet wired
rules: Paint is clipped inside panel face, excluding dark gutters and structural trim.
Deck decoration never crosses the physical rim/cap or hides adjacent controls.
Mounts share original nine-button anchors and sloping deck perspective.
Original source pixels stay unchanged until exact cap/rim masks are authored and verified.
